playlist.video_title: Gradient descent, how neural networks learn
playlist.why: Understanding the training process is essential because it provides the foundation for how neural networks adjust their parameters to reduce errors, which is crucial for grasping more advanced concepts of model optimization later.

narration: In this learning path, you will explore the training process of neural networks. Given your background in linear algebra and understanding of neural networks, this training process will illuminate how these models learn and improve over time through techniques like gradient descent.
